sources.supporting_note: Drivers are using detours on four bus routes because a maintenance project closes a corridor.
Two of the four routes return to normal paths after the north part of the corridor reopens. The other two routes remain on detour.
One more route returns to its normal path Thursday evening. One route remains on detour at Friday cutoff; its return date is not set.
A community clinic announces it will close at the end of the month after its lease ends.
The clinic signs an agreement to transfer its existing patients to two partner sites. The agreement does not guarantee that every appointment will keep its current date.
Inspection finds a damaged filter at a neighborhood treatment facility. The facility issues a boil-water notice while repairs and tests take place.
The filter is repaired, required samples meet the standard and the boil-water notice is lifted. The clearance applies to this facility and does not evaluate other infrastructure.
